content.title: Cal-Maine Foods (CALM) Profit Margin Nearly Doubles, Challenging Skepticism Over Operational Resilience
content.summary: Cal-Maine Foods (CALM) reported a striking net profit margin of 28.9%, up from 16.1% a year ago, highlighting substantial gains in operational efficiency. Annual earnings growth soared to 198.5%, well above the company’s five-year average growth of 51.3% per year, marking yet another year of robust performance. content.title: Cal-Maine Sees Fancy Eggs Drive Growth As Specialty Varieties Capture More Shopper Attention
content.summary: Cal-Maine Foods, Inc. (NASDAQ:CALM), the largest egg producer in the United States, on Wednesday announced financial results for the first quarter of fiscal 2026. The company posted a net income of $199.34 million, a 32.9% increase year-over-year, with diluted earnings per share rising 34.6% to $4.12, falling short of analyst expectations of $5.35 per share. content.title: Cal-Maine (NASDAQ:CALM) Misses Q3 Sales Expectations, Stock Drops
content.summary: Egg company Cal-Maine Foods (NASDAQ:CALM) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, but sales rose 17.4% year on year to $922.6 million. Its GAAP profit of $4.12 per share was 19.2% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
